query: Which classroom-ready interventions and micro-teaching modules could be piloted to translate CA findings on repair initiation into measurable pedagogical outcomes?

response.query: Which classroom-ready interventions and micro-teaching modules could be piloted to translate CA findings on repair initiation into measurable pedagogical outcomes?
response.answer: Classroom-ready interventions include peer-led repair sessions and teacher-facilitated reflection workshops. Micro-teaching modules focus on modeling repair strategies and student feedback techniques. These aim to improve student communication and comprehension.
